verdict.rationale: The INPI Guichet unique is a government online filing portal, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence describes an MCP server or any agent connector for the Guichet unique. The keyless JSON API probe concerns a separate state company-data API (recherche-entreprises), not the Guichet unique, and is not an MCP server, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
